author: XBOX
description:
Colossus plays, world resonates.Shoot the Mood, Hit the Groove! 🎸🔥
Season 5 of the free-to-play strange worlds survival game, Once Human, drops on November 18 (PT). In "Dissonant Resonance," your arsenal becomes an instrument. Step into four erratic Emotion Zones where every bullet strikes a note and every kill fuels an emotion. Collect dropped notes, purify corrupted scores, and team up with your squad for the ultimate challenge.

Waiting on the other side? A colossal pipe-organ machine god. Adapt on the fly, dodge its dynamic attacks, and survive the ultimate musical raid.
Play Once Human for FREE on XBOX Series X|S and Windows PC. XBOX Game Pass members can also claim exclusive bundles.
